_note: Default bin rules. Change these to match your own city's collection rules. The classifier only knows the 6 material classes; this file maps each one to a bin.

cardboard.tip: Flatten the box and keep it dry.

paper.tip: Clean, dry paper only (no greasy or waxed paper, tissues or toilet paper).

glass.tip: Empty and rinse bottles and jars; remove lids.

metal.tip: Empty and rinse cans; do not crush if your city asks for whole cans.

plastic.tip: Empty and rinse; check the number on the bottom against your city's list.

trash.tip: Items that fit none of the recycling classes go to the garbage.
